en_title: Take-Two 'Enhancing' Technical Defenses and Legal Activities to Combat GTA 6 AI Reverse-Engineering Threat
cn_title: Take-Two正「加强」技术防御和法律行动，以应对《GTA6》遭AI逆向工程的威胁
opus_summary: Take-Two首席执行官Strauss Zelnick表示，公司正着力加强技术防御并适当加强法律行动，以应对AI辅助逆向工程带来的挑战。他认为盗版可能在不同程度上影响公司业务，但局面可以控制。

paragraphs.en: The boss of Rockstar parent company Take-Two has responded to the threat of AI-assisted reverse-engineering and decompilation of games ahead of the crucial launch of GTA 6 .
paragraphs.cn: 在《GTA6》迎来关键发售之际，Rockstar母公司Take-Two的负责人回应了AI辅助游戏逆向工程和反编译带来的威胁。

paragraphs.en: As you've probably seen from various viral clips on social media, people are using AI to create clones of popular games and release them on platforms they're not normally available on. We've seen everything from Minecraft playable inside X/Twitter to modders crashing Minecraft and Elden Ring together . Indeed, last month, Rockstar's own Grand Theft Auto 5 was made playable in a browser before it was pulled offline.
paragraphs.cn: 你可能已经从社交媒体上的各种热视频中看到，人们正在使用AI制作热门游戏的克隆版，并将其发布到这些游戏通常无法游玩的平台上。我们见过各种例子，从可以在X/X内游玩的《我的世界》，到模组制作者将《我的世界》和《艾尔登法环》拼凑在一起。事实上，上个月，Rockstar自家的《侠盗猎车手5》也曾被制作成可在浏览器中游玩的版本，随后被下线。

paragraphs.en: Seemingly in response, Anthropic issued an update for Claude that made it harder for people to use the AI model to generate video game clones. But there is perhaps a greater concern: that GTA 6 could pop up on PC soon after it hits PlayStation and Xbox in unofficial form.
paragraphs.cn: Anthropic似乎对此作出了回应，为Claude发布了一项更新，使人们更难使用这一AI模型生成电子游戏克隆版。但或许还有一个更大的担忧：《GTA6》登陆PlayStation和XBOX后不久，可能就会以非官方形式出现在PC上。

paragraphs.en: While there is some scepticism about the true threat here, recent discussions around tools like Claude have sparked speculation that AI can quickly decompile or recompile complex console games like GTA 6 into PC ports. And some believe the AI threat could force Rockstar into changing its plans. In an interview with IGN sister site RPS last week, former Rockstar North technical director Obbe Vermeij said that Rockstar Games may be keen to port GTA 6 to PC as soon as possible , due to the explosion of AI-generated clones and ports.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管有人对这一威胁的真实程度持怀疑态度，近期围绕Claude等工具的讨论还是引发了猜测：AI能够迅速反编译或重新编译《GTA6》这类复杂的主机游戏，将其移植到PC上。还有人认为，AI带来的威胁可能迫使Rockstar改变计划。在上周接受IGN姊妹网站RPS采访时，Rockstar North前技术总监Obbe Vermeij表示，由于AI生成的克隆版和移植版大量涌现，Rockstar可能急于尽快将《GTA6》移植到PC。

paragraphs.en: Some of this concern has to do with the security of the PS5, with Sony seemingly engaged in a game of Whac-a-Mole with hackers who are trying to jailbreak the latest firmware ahead of the release of GTA 6. If a PS5 jailbreak is made available for the firmware that is required by GTA 6 to run, it may be possible for Rockstar’s game to be pirated on PS5 and subsequently made available on PC.
paragraphs.cn: 部分担忧与PS5的安全性有关：索尼似乎正在与黑客打一场「打地鼠」游戏，后者试图在《GTA6》发售前破解最新固件。如果《GTA6》运行所需的PS5固件出现了可用的越狱方法，Rockstar的这款游戏就可能在PS5上遭到盗版，随后被搬到PC上。

paragraphs.en: IGN asked Strauss Zelnick, CEO of Take-Two, about this existential threat in a recent interview — and it’s fair to say he’s taking it seriously, while also insisting that fans will prefer to play GTA 6 officially, with all its bells and whistles as Rockstar intended, over an unofficial PC version.
paragraphs.cn: IGN在最近的一次采访中向Take-Two首席执行官Strauss Zelnick询问了这一生存威胁。可以说，他正在认真对待这一问题，同时也坚持认为，比起非官方PC版，玩家会更愿意游玩官方版《GTA6》，体验Rockstar所设想的全部丰富内容。

paragraphs.en: IGN: We've seen hackers using AI to clone games much faster than ever before, even try to jailbreak consoles. And there is some concern about this leading to potentially GTA 6 being made available on PC unofficially or places that you aren't releasing it. I was just wondering how much of a threat this is to your business? And, is there anything meaningful you can do about it?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：我们看到黑客利用AI以前所未有的速度克隆游戏，甚至尝试破解主机。有人担心，这可能导致《GTA6》以非官方形式出现在PC或你们没有发布游戏的平台上。我想知道，这对你们的业务构成了多大威胁？另外，你们能采取什么有意义的措施来应对吗？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: I don't think it’s a financial matter, in terms of a threat to our business. I do think it’s a creative matter. It's important to everyone, our developers and our consumers alike, to deliver the experience Rockstar envisions. And at the same time, of course, we protect our intellectual property vigilantly. So we are focused on these concerns. We're not in the least cavalier about them. Technology is advancing quickly. And at the same time, I do think that pretty much everyone wants the Rockstar experience as Rockstar intended.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：就对我们业务的威胁而言，我不认为这是一个财务问题。我确实认为这是一个创意问题。呈现Rockstar设想的体验对所有人都很重要，无论是我们的开发者还是消费者。当然，与此同时，我们也在警惕地保护我们的知识产权。因此，我们正在关注这些问题，绝没有对它们掉以轻心。技术发展迅速。与此同时，我确实认为，几乎所有人都想要Rockstar原本设想的体验。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Related, last week Anthropic confirmed they took steps to block Claude from reverse engineering video games. I would assume you would welcome that. And would you like to see other AI companies like OpenAI do the same thing to prevent people from using these powerful AI models to clone your games?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：与此相关，上周Anthropic证实，他们采取了措施，阻止Claude对电子游戏进行逆向工程。我想你应该欢迎这一举措。那么，你是否希望OpenAI等其他AI公司也采取同样的行动，防止人们利用这些强大的AI模型克隆你们的游戏？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: I think all companies should be protecting intellectual property, their own and everyone else's. And if you're in the intellectual property business, which Anthropic is and OpenAI is, then it seems ironic on the one hand to stomp on someone else's IP and hope that yours is protected.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：我认为所有公司都应该保护知识产权，无论是自己的还是其他所有人的。如果你从事的是知识产权业务，而Anthropic和OpenAI都是如此，那么一方面践踏别人的知识产权，一方面又希望自己的知识产权受到保护，似乎很讽刺。

paragraphs.en: During an investor-focused Q&A after the release of Take-Two’s latest financial report, attended by IGN, Zelnick was asked multiple times about this AI reverse-engineering problem. He, again, had strong words in response, suggesting Take-Two was ready to lawyer up.
paragraphs.cn: 在Take-Two发布最新财报后举行的一场面向投资者的问答活动中，Zelnick多次被问及这一AI逆向工程问题，IGN也参加了这场活动。他再次作出了措辞强硬的回应，暗示Take-Two已准备好诉诸法律。

paragraphs.en: “This business has been largely immune to piracy concerns forever because of file sizes, complexity of piracy, being connected to servers and the like,” he began. “And undoubtedly, it would be very difficult to replicate the experience of consuming our game as intended because of technical limitations.
paragraphs.cn: 他首先表示：「一直以来，由于文件大小、盗版的复杂性、与服务器的连接等因素，这项业务在很大程度上不受盗版问题的影响。毫无疑问，由于技术限制，要复制按我们设想的方式体验游戏的感受将非常困难。

paragraphs.en: “That said, it's going to become more of a challenge, as you said, and we're aware of that. So we are utterly focused on enhancing our technical defenses and enhancing our legal activities appropriately. And at the same time, without in any way being cavalier, every entertainment business that exists is subject to some element of piracy. So this is likely to invade our business to a greater or lesser extent. I think it will be manageable and we are focused on it.”
paragraphs.cn: 「话虽如此，正如你所说，这会变得更具挑战性，我们也意识到了这一点。因此，我们正全力加强技术防御，并适当加强法律行动。与此同时，虽然我们绝不会掉以轻心，但现有的每一项娱乐业务都在某种程度上受到盗版影响。因此，这很可能会或多或少地侵扰我们的业务。我认为这将是可控的，而我们正在关注这个问题。」

paragraphs.en: Zelnick’s talk about legal activities sparks an obvious question: what can game companies do about AI-assisted reverse engineering? In a recent IGN feature exploring the impact of AI cloning on GTA 6 , head of Nightdive Studios, Stephen Kick, suggested lawyers have already sprung into action.
paragraphs.cn: Zelnick谈及法律行动，引出了一个显而易见的问题：游戏公司能如何应对AI辅助的逆向工程？在IGN最近一篇探讨AI克隆对《GTA6》影响的专题报道中，Nightdive Studios负责人Stephen Kick暗示，律师们已经迅速行动起来。

paragraphs.en: “I can't even imagine what the lawyers are going through right now with all the major publishers,” he said. "What do we do? How many cease and desist letters do we need to send out? How can we capitalize on this? How can we integrate this into our own business model right now?"
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「我简直无法想象，现在各大发行商的律师们正在经历什么。我们该怎么办？我们需要发出多少封停止侵权函？我们如何利用这一点获利？我们现在如何将其整合进自己的商业模式？」

paragraphs.en: The PlayStation homebrew scene has made headlines in the last month for releasing PS5 jailbreaks for prior firmwares. For example, late September, a jailbreak that supported all PS5 consoles running firmware 7.00-13.60 sent shockwaves through the homebrew community because, at the time, it meant that all PS5s, including the PS5 Pro, that hadn't been updated within the previous week were compatible with the jailbreak. This was of huge significance for Sony and the security of the PS5, as people with a jailbroken PS5 can modify their console, potentially opening the door to video game piracy. However, it was found that some PS5 games subsequently required the more recent 14.00 firmware in order to download updates, sparking a renewed effort to release a new jailbreak for the updated system software.
paragraphs.cn: 过去一个月，PlayStation自制软件社区因发布针对旧版PS5固件的越狱方法而登上新闻头条。例如，9月下旬，一种支持所有运行7.00至13.60版固件的PS5主机的越狱方法在自制软件社区引发震动，因为在当时，这意味着所有在此前一周内没有更新的PS5，包括PS5 Pro，都与该越狱方法兼容。这对索尼和PS5的安全性意义重大，因为拥有已越狱PS5的用户可以修改自己的主机，从而可能为电子游戏盗版打开大门。然而，后来人们发现，部分PS5游戏需要更新至较新的14.00版固件才能下载更新，这促使人们重新努力，为更新后的系统软件发布新的越狱方法。

paragraphs.en: So, there is a game of Whac-A-Mole at play where the homebrew scene is working to release a new jailbreak for the latest PS5 firmware, then do it all over again when Sony releases a new firmware update designed to beef up security. Some believe GTA 6 will require at least 14.20 or potentially 14.22. And Sony may release further security updates before November 19.
paragraphs.cn: 因此，一场「打地鼠」游戏正在上演：自制软件社区努力为最新的PS5固件发布新的越狱方法，然后当索尼发布旨在加强安全性的新固件更新时，又要从头再来。有人认为，《GTA6》将至少需要14.20版固件，也可能需要14.22版。而索尼可能会在11月19日之前发布更多安全更新。

paragraphs.en: The question for Sony is whether it can do enough to eventually win this game of Whac-A-Mole with the homebrew scene. This is something of an existential crisis for the PlayStation manufacturer, which publishers and developers rely upon for the security of their PlayStation releases. But with the emergence of powerful AI models, the stakes have risen significantly.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼面临的问题是，它能否采取足够的措施，最终赢得与自制软件社区之间的这场「打地鼠」游戏。对于这家PlayStation制造商来说，这在某种程度上是一场生存危机，发行商和开发者都依靠它来保障其PlayStation游戏的安全。但随着强大AI模型的出现，风险已大幅增加。
